Application Developer 
 

 On behalf of our client, Procom Services is searching for an Application Developer for a contract opportunity in Hillsboro, OR.
 

 Application Developer Job Details 
 

 Programmer to develop applications at customer's direction. Focus on development of software Iife-cycle.
 

 Application Developer Mandatory Skills 
 

 .Net, C# Desktop Application WinForms, AngularJS, WiX, XML, USB.
 Works closely with Technical customers to establish requirements and schedules.
 Coordinated efforts with other developers, planned high Ievel architecture for solutions, coded software to spec, tracks and resolves software defects.
 

 Application Developer Start Date 
 

 ASAP
 

 Application Developer Assignment Length 
 

 6+ months
 

 "Please note that we are not able to work with candidates on H1B Visas or candidates represented by third parties." 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Please send your resume in Word format only.
